pages.title: The Lance Charge
pages.text: The Doll Lance is the only weapon that arms a doll for melee — a doll cannot hold a sword. On the attack order the doll flies at its target at twice its usual speed, then flies back to the player.

Special cases$(br2)When a doll holds nothing that can attack and has at least one hand free, it slaps instead, and the slap is the doll's own 1 damage.$(br2)Danmaku outranks the lance$(br2)A doll holding any danmaku item keeps shooting and never charges.

Charge limits$(br2)A charge only starts from within 16 blocks of its target and never carries the doll more than 20 blocks from where it began — past that it turns back, and a target that keeps pulling away is simply dropped. An attack order no doll could reach is refused outright.
